Here is a check on the life of a TCP connection.

```quiz
{"mode":"practice","questions":[{"type":"order","question":"Put the life of a TCP connection in order.","items":["Client sends SYN","Server replies SYN-ACK","Client sends ACK","Data is exchanged","FIN closes the connection"],"explanation":"The handshake comes first, then data, then the FIN exchange that tears the connection down."},{"question":"Which protocol resolves an IPv4 address to a MAC address on the local segment?","options":["ARP","DNS","DHCP","ICMP"],"answer":"A","explanation":"ARP maps a next-hop IPv4 address to the hardware address that frames are sent to."}]}
```
